title: Preparation of graphene oxide based on microcrystalline graphite: the study of microwave absorption properties
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,26082-26090

Yunsheng Zheng, Zhijun Ma, Xingyuan Weng, Liang Cheng, Ying Qin
The few-layer MGO-1.0 exhibits a RLmin reaching −18.39 dB and an EAB is 3.06 GHz (7.97–11.03 GHz) at the frequency of 9.42 GHz. These originate from the synergistic effects of dipole polarization, defect polarization, and conductive loss.
